verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha … and said to him:
How are the awakening factors defined?”

verses.pali: “‘Bodhāya saṁvattantī’ti kho, bhikkhu, tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccanti.
verses.english: “Mendicant, they’re called awakening factors because they lead to awakening.
A mendicant develops the awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion,

verses.pali: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vossaggapariṇāmiṁ.
verses.english: and equanimity, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.
They’re called awakening factors because they lead to awakening.”
